thread:
Maya: quick heads-up — I just got paged (pagerbot) for a p95 latency surge hitting eu-west inference pool. I have a 1hr sync starting in 5m, can someone take primary for the next ~90m? I can stay shadow/secondary until I'm free.

pagerbot: Incident Alert — inference-eu-west latency_p95 > 950ms (threshold 400ms). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Current open pages: 1. Incident ID: INC-2026-459.

Zhen: I can take primary. Oncall calendar shows Leo is already shadow for the midnight window — Leo, you good remaining secondary?

Leo: yeah I can stay secondary. thanks Zhen. Maya, do you want me to take over the page and follow the runbook?

Maya: yes please. Major asks: 1) confirm throttles are not global, 2) follow the latency runbook step 1-3, 3) verify no customer-facing 5xx spike. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-p95

Ian: tagging the quick mitigation checklist from runbook — copying relevant bits here: 

```
# quick mitigation (p95)
1) Check autoscale pools: `k8s get hpa -n inference eu-west-pool` and compare desired vs current
2) Check GPU-health and OOMs: `infra-monitor gpu-heartbeat --region eu-west`
3) If small scale issue, trigger warm-up reroute: `rctl route set --policy warm-fallback --target eu-west-warm` (5m rollback)
4) If degraded, promote shadow instance as primary via `oncall-cli promote --pool eu-west --instance <id>`
```

Zhen: I ran `k8s get hpa -n inference eu-west-pool` — desired replicas 12, current 9. Checking logs now.

Leo: I'm pulling 1m token-level cost + latency on the affected model: https://console.redwood/metrics?m=inference-eu-west&p=latency (on my screen p95 spiked to 1.1s at 02:11UTC). No 5xx spike in the last 10m (5xx = 0.1% baseline -> 0.12% now).

Zhen: GPU heartbeat shows 2 nodes with elevated load and one node reported transient CUDA timeout but no OOMs. Suggest triggering warm-fallback routing to reduce tail latency while we scale.

Maya: agree. Zhen, if you can kick the warm-fallback and confirm, I'll mark the schedule swap in the oncall calendar and hand my primary slack duties off.

Zhen: executing: `rctl route set --policy warm-fallback --target eu-west-warm --reason "p95 surge"`

ops-bot: Action logged — route change applied by Zhen at 02:12UTC. Change ID: RCT-8492. Auto-rollback set for 5m unless confirmed.

Zhen: warm-fallback applied. Observing metrics... p95 dropped to 580ms in ~40s. Continuing to scale HPA.

Maya: I'm updating the oncall roster now — marking Zhen primary 02:12-03:42 UTC, Maya shadow -> secondary after meeting. (link to calendar): https://calendar.redwood/oncall?date=2026-03-15

ops-bot: Oncall swap recorded: Primary=Maya -> Zhen (02:12-03:42UTC). Shadow/Secondary remains Leo. Swap ID: SWP-3321.

Leo: quick reminder — if you need to promote a specific instance, follow the promote command and then validate by checking KV cache hit-rate: `redis-cli -h kv-eu-west info | grep hits` — a cold promote will show a transient drop.

Ian: Also quick audit note: add a short blameless note in INC-2026-459 summarizing the warm-fallback + HPA scaling, so SEs and support know why latency changed.

Zhen: scaling HPA — issuing `kubectl scale --replicas=13 deployment/eu-worker` now.

pagerbot: Paging update — incident INC-2026-459: warm-fallback applied, HPA scale to 13 in progress. Post-mitigations p95: 560ms. No customer-error rate increase detected.

Maya: thanks team. Zhen — take any alerts. I'm in the meeting but reachable if things go weird. Leave a short note in the incident timeline when you hand back to me.

Zhen: noted. I'll hand back when metrics stabilize and HPA settles. ETA ~40-60m.

Leo: LGTM. If anything spikes I can take over immediate page for the next 30m while Zhen runs checks. :thumbsup:

Maya: confirmed — thanks. Leaving the thread open for handback.

Zhen: follow-up at 02:36UTC — HPA at 13, p95 steady ~420-480ms, no 5xx regression. Preparing to remove warm-fallback in 10m and hand primary back to Maya after your meeting.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — auto-rollback warm-fallback in 5m unless confirmed by oncall.

Maya: back online at 02:42UTC. Thanks all. Zhen, can you remove the warm-fallback and confirm steady metrics?

Zhen: removing warm-fallback: `rctl route unset --id RCT-8492 --confirm`

ops-bot: Route change applied by Zhen at 02:43UTC. RCT-8492 rolled back.

Zhen: post-rollback p95 410ms, HPA stable at 13, 5xx = 0.09%. Handing primary back to Maya.

ops-bot: Oncall swap recorded: Primary=Zhen -> Maya (02:43UTC). Swap ID: SWP-3321-CLOSE.

Maya: back as primary, confirmed metrics look healthy. Filing incident note now and closing the page if no further alerts. Thanks everyone for quick handoff. :heart:
